name: Bracers of Binding
summary: Keeper Bel'varil in Tarren Mill says the Magus, busy with the stone tokens you gathered, will eventually want their counterpart: bracers of binding. You are to collect four Bracers of Earth Binding from elementals among the ruins of Dalaran.

sections.title: Bracers of Earth Binding
sections.body: While the Magus studies the stone tokens you gathered, Bel'varil expects a further wish: samples of the matching piece, bracers of binding. Worn on an elemental's wrists, they tie it to a mage's service. Among the ruins of Dalaran, elementals wear them. Bel'varil wants four Bracers of Earth Binding brought to Tarren Mill.

faq.answer: Keeper Bel'varil, in Tarren Mill, after you gathered the stone tokens.

faq.q: What are the bracers used for?
aliases: what do bracers of binding do
faq.answer: They are set around the wrists of elementals and bind them into a mage's service.
In the ruins of Dalaran, which lie in the Alterac Mountains.

faq.q: Why does Keeper Bel'varil want them?
faq.answer: Bel'varil knows the Magus will eventually want examples of the bracers, the counterpart of the stone tokens the Magus is studying.
Stone Tokens, in which you gathered the stone tokens the Magus is now studying.
